put.summary: Marks events up to the given offset as consumed for the given subscription.
put.description: Marks events up to the given offset as consumed for the given subscription.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the subscription to pull events from. Subscription must be of type PULL.

requestBody.description: The cursor where to start the next getSubscriptionEvents pull

200.description: Events where successfully marked as consumed.

createdAt.description: The date at which the event was originally created.

sourceName.description: The name of the source system.

sourceId.description: The id in the source system.

sourceUrl.description: The url of the source system.

workspaceId.description: An optional UUID if the event is related to a workspace.

userId.description: An optional UUID if the event is related to a user.

tags.description: a list of tags describing the nature of this event, used to find subscriptions for this event

items.description: a list of tags describing the nature of this event, used to find subscriptions for this event

payload.description: Contains the event the publisher wants to send wrapped inside this webhooks event here.

deactivationNotificationEnabled.description: Email notification is sent on automatic subscription deactivation.

SubscriptionVisibility.description:
Specifies the visibility of the subscription. 
PRIVATE: The subscription is only visible to the user who created it.
WORKSPACE: The subscription is visible to all users in the workspace.

maxBatchSize.description: Used when 'deliveryType' is 'PULL'. The desired maximum size (in kiB) of the returned batch of events. Default is 512. This is an approximate number: Actual responses may be smaller, or bigger when there is one single event exceeding maxBatchSize.

ignoreError.description: Don't re-send events that caused an error on PUSH. Shirks the at-least-once policy!

deactivationNotificationEnabled.description: Email notification is sent on automatic subscription deactivation.

description.description: Provides a description for the subscription.

payloadMode.description: Specifies the behavior of the payload property of a delivery for this subscription:  DEFAULT -> get only the payload property of the event (default behavior), WRAPPED_EVENT -> get the whole serialized event as the payload, NO_PAYLOAD -> get always an empty {} payload

deliveryType.description: The discriminator property to differentiate between subscription types.

workspaceConstraint.description: Specifies how the workspaceId is used on events:  WORKSPACE -> get events with specified workspaceId (workspaceId must not be null), NO_WORKSPACE -> get events that have no workspaceId (workspaceId must be null), ANY -> get all events regardless if a workspaceId is assigned or not on the event

createdAt.description: The date at which the delivery was originally created.

eventProcessingTime.description: Time it took to process the event in milliseconds.
